result.mfn_sunset_period: 12 months from the 2022 Effective Date (50 bps cushion; excludes New Incremental Term Loans Incurred under Section 4.04(b)(1)(ii) of Annex I, established under the second proviso to Section 4.04(b)(1), maturing more than 2 years after the 2022 Term Loan Maturity Date, or Incurred in connection with an acquisition). TLB1&3 Incremental Term Loans used to refinance remaining March 2017/October 2018 term loans get a 0 bps MFN with no sunset.
result.anchor_clause: "in the event that prior to the date that is twelve (12) months from the 2022 Effective Date, the Borrower seeks Incremental Term Loan Commitments pursuant to Section 2.22 of the Credit Agreement, ... the All- In Yield applicable to such New Incremental Term Loans denominated in the same currency as the 2022 Refinancing Term Loans (other than New Incremental Term Loans (w) Incurred pursuant to Section 4.04(b)(1)(ii) of Annex I of the Credit Agreement, (x) established pursuant to the second proviso to Section 4.04(b)(1) of Annex I of the Credit Agreement, (y) having a maturity date that is more than two (2) years after the 2022 Term Loan Maturity Date or (z) Incurred in connection with an acquisition) shall not be greater than the applicable All-In Yield payable pursuant to the terms of the Loan Documents as amended through the date of such calculation with respect to the 2022 Refinancing Term Loans plus 50 basis points per annum"

lme_vectors.rationale: The excerpt covers only yield protection (MFN) on incremental term loans; the actual incremental and ratio-debt capacity sits in Section 4.04(b)(1) of Annex I, which is not reproduced here, and the MFN has a 12-month sunset and broad carve-outs.
lme_vectors.basis: 50 bps MFN for 12 months on same-currency New Incremental Term Loans. Excluded: debt under Section 4.04(b)(1)(ii) or the second proviso to 4.04(b)(1), debt maturing more than 2 years after the 2022 Term Loan Maturity Date, and acquisition debt.
lme_vectors.quote: (y) having a maturity date that is more than two (2) years after the 2022 Term Loan Maturity Date or (z) Incurred in connection with an acquisition
